data.name: CINERIS SOMNIA
data.detailed_description:
About CINERIS SOMNIA


CINERIS SOMNIA is a 3D adventure through a beautifully strange and mesmerizing world.

STORY



A young girl awakens on the seashore.

All that remain are her sister’s yellow bucket and the sand castle they had just made together.
Her mother is nowhere to be seen.

Blinded by the dazzling sunlight, the young girl takes her first step on a strange, mysterious journey...

CHARACTERS

The Girl


An innocent and curious girl.
Wearing her favorite blue sundress, she came to the seashore for a picnic together with her mother and little sister.
But upon awakening from her nap, she realizes that she is now all alone.

Charlotte


A young confined to a sanatorium, her body rife with illness.
She is very quiet and has an air of maturity far beyond most children of her age.
She waits longingly for promises made long ago with someone very special to be fulfilled.

Marie


Marie is a cheerful, pure, and active girl.
She whimsically runs around the dark depths of the forest, wearing her pajamas and a cape.
But there is an important reason she came to this forest.

Ophelia


Daughter of a prestigious family owning vast lands and an extravagant mansion.
She is plagued by intense self-loathing due to her belief that she is ugly and plain.
Raised by cold and unloving parents, she spends her days in loneliness and despair, following the orders of her mother and father.

The Tall Man


A mysterious tall man with black clothes, blue hair, and golden eyes.

SYSTEM

●Autosave

While you can save your game anytime, an autosave feature is also included.
However, it is recommended that you to save your game often.

●Map
Once you acquire the map, you can check it anytime.
You'll need to work out your location on your own, but you will receive many hints as well, such as what to check and where to go.

●Destination Guidance
This can be used to check your current destination or purpose at any given time.
However, you are not required to follow this guide at all times.
You may even make some new and interesting discoveries by stopping at different places along the way.

●Controls

SOUNDTRACK

The original soundtrack is available as DLC. However, the radio music "Luna" was used specially in the game with permission from Maou Damashii, and is not included in the soundtrack.

DEVELOPER'S COMMENTS

We started developing this game based on a few simple ideas: "Let's make a 3D game," and "Can we portray the stories and world we've imagined as a video game?"
And finally, the game is here.
We hope you have a wonderful experience traversing this strange world and unraveling the story, as well as taking a deeper look into concepts such as purity, ugliness, joy, and anxiety - some of the complex and constantly moving parts that make up the human psyche.

reviews.review:
It may not be a very scary horror game, but it has a wonderful story, atmosphere, and especially art direction and music. It's a collection of short stories type of game with a tall strange man as your narrative vehicle. The game is really more focused on executing its stories as an investigative experience where you uncover the past of dilapidated  areas involving a specific person; the gameplay is essentially a walking simulator with very simple puzzles, however, I think the game understands the downsides of this focus and actually is able to adapt the other elements of the game well to fit said focus. For example, the maps are not too big, and are very easy to navigate and remember; as for the puzzles, they are done in a way where it feeds into the game's linearity; when the game doesn't tell you the objective and you're about to get lost, they place a trigger at the exit that gives you a point of interest, keeping the linearity while preserving the immersion and not feeling too hand-holding. They also try to give you clues via the pictures provided with the objective on your diary, and the map is designed in a way where areas you don't need to go yet are closed, so you don't waste too much time getting lost. Basically the game mitigates its weaknesses of having very basic and not engaging gameplay, by taking a sort of "theater play" approach with the player where they subtly direct the player like an actor through triggers and story pacing. It's essentially a visual novel but with the added aspect of a 3rd person horror game. 

Overall, it's not for everyone, but it's for some people definitely, and that includes me. The gorgeous atmosphere is paired with a really good soundtrack (that I wish they played more often) and the maps are so good looking with that gothic style of foundation in both architecture, textures, rendering, and even in the character designs (like the old DMC games for example), and probably my favourite part of its maps is that, just like in most horror games, it adapts to the tempo of the story. While you explore the same place over and over, it changes visually and sometimes spatially depending on the point of the story and I think the way they did it successfully adds to the storytelling. As for the story, you'll just have to trust all the reviews here including mine that says its good. 

Overall it's a great game that should be spread around more to horror fans that are more into atmosphere and story, and maybe also to people who want to try to get into horror but are very easily scared; the way this game "scares" you is not through jumpscares, but good ol eerie-ness, creepy atmosphere and dredge. This game really just puts all its chips into its atmosphere, and I think it paid off. Plus, what do you have to lose when it goes on sale for cheap.
